/* V4.3.8 — agreed option 1 hierarchy: one welcoming hero, detailed progress only below. */
.op1-root{background:#f7fcff}
.op1-hero{overflow:hidden;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.op1-welcome{height:auto;min-height:185px;max-height:none;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);justify-content:center;border-radius:25px}
.op1-welcome-top{padding:22px 24px 24px}
.op1-welcome h1{font-size:clamp(39px,3.3vw,50px)}
.op1-welcome p{font-size:clamp(19px,1.55vw,25px);line-height:1.26;margin-top:8px}
.op1-welcome .op1-welcome-guide{font-size:clamp(17px,1.2vw,20px);margin-top:12px;color:#3b6694;font-weight:600}
.op1-worlds{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#edf8ff 0%,#f7fcff 100%)}
.op1-progress{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#e3f4ff,#dff3ff)}
.op1-progress .op1-section-desc{font-size:17px;margin:3px 0 12px}
.op1-stat{grid-template-rows:minmax(43px,1fr) 22px;min-height:113px}
.op1-stat-text small{font-size:15px;line-height:1.16;margin-top:4px}
.op1-stat-meter{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:100%;min-width:0}
.op1-stat-meter .op1-stat-deco{flex:1;min-width:0;height:11px;display:block}
.op1-stat-meter small{color:#14366c;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;min-width:33px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.op1-parent-tip{font-size:15px}
@media(max-width:880px){.op1-welcome{min-height:170px;max-width:calc(100% - 35px)}.op1-progress .op1-section-desc{font-size:16px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.op1-hero{height:310px;background-size:auto 310px}.op1-welcome{top:18px;transform:none;min-height:145px;height:auto;left:9px;right:9px;width:calc(100% - 18px);max-width:none}.op1-welcome-top{padding:18px 17px 19px}.op1-welcome h1{font-size:31px}.op1-welcome p{font-size:18px}.op1-welcome .op1-welcome-guide{font-size:16px;margin-top:8px}.op1-stat{min-height:96px;grid-template-rows:minmax(44px,1fr) 21px}.op1-stat-text small{font-size:13px}.op1-stat-meter small{font-size:13px}.op1-progress .op1-section-desc{font-size:15px}}


/* QA-only reward prototype: real exercise UI remains the visual source of truth. */
body.reward-preview-mode .reward-preview-feedback{position:absolute;z-index:7;right:clamp(20px,5vw,82px);top:clamp(160px,15vw,240px);width:min(33vw,365px);min-width:265px;min-height:168px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:15px 16px;border-radius:30px;border:2px solid #ffdb83;background:linear-gradient(132deg,#fffefa 4%,#fff2cf 100%);box-shadow:0 18px 45px #785d2224;animation:reward-pop .4s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.45,1)}
.reward-preview-feedback .reward-bot{width:114px;flex-shrink:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 5px #25517d29);animation:reward-bounce .65s ease-out}
.reward-preview-words{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;align-items:flex-start;min-width:0}
.reward-preview-feedback strong{font-size:clamp(21px,2vw,30px);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.4px;color:#071f54}
.reward-preview-feedback small{font-size:16px;color:#24416d;font-weight:750}
.reward-preview-coin,.reward-flying-coin{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:55px;height:55px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #eea20a;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff1af,inset 0 -5px 0 #dd8c0d,0 7px 16px #ad7a2238;color:#a36b05;background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 28%,#fff7c2 0%,#ffdc64 30%,#ffb42e 72%,#d9910c 100%);font-size:37px;font-weight:900;line-height:1}
.reward-preview-coin{width:49px;height:49px;font-size:32px}
.reward-preview-total{border:2px solid #ffdb83!important;box-shadow:0 6px 23px #d4a54125!important}
.reward-preview-total .reward-coin-symbol{font-size:41px;color:#e7a111;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 1px #d88910);line-height:1}
.reward-prototype-tools{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px clamp(20px,4.45vw,80px) 0;font-size:14px}
.reward-prototype-tools .reward-demo-trigger{border:2px dashed #a9c9e5;border-radius:14px;color:#24528a;background:#fff;min-height:44px;padding:7px 15px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
.reward-preview-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;color:#21446c;background:#e9f4ff;font-weight:800}
.reward-flying-coin{position:fixed;z-index:1000;pointer-events:none;margin:0}
.reward-preview-end{min-height:calc(100vh - 30px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:15px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%,#fff5cd 0%,#fffaf0 55%,#e3f5ff 100%);padding:110px 22px 42px!important;border:0!important;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}
.reward-preview-end h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,64px);font-weight:900;color:#071f54;margin:8px 0 0}
.reward-preview-end p{font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,24px);color:#294b73;margin:0;max-width:580px}
.reward-preview-badge{background:#fff;padding:10px 17px;border-radius:99px;color:#184879;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 5px 19px #284e711c}
.reward-chest{width:min(450px,80vw);height:290px;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 16px #1a35532b)}
.reward-chest::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:100%;height:84%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#ffe7a6 0%,#ffe7a600 70%);transform:scale(1.2)}
.reward-chest-lid{position:absolute;z-index:4;top:47px;width:72%;height:97px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:11px solid #db9718;border-bottom:9px solid #ffc751;border-radius:100px 100px 24px 24px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0b4791 0 47px,#1a77bc 47px 92px);box-shadow:inset 0 11px #70bafb,0 8px 0 #80551c;transform-origin:40% 100%;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.17,.76,.25,1)}
.reward-chest-box{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:129px;width:76%;height:128px;border:11px solid #e6a72d;border-radius:23px 23px 32px 32px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#09529c 0 50px,#1679be 50px 96px);box-shadow:inset 0 8px #65aeef,inset 0 -13px #083f78,0 12px 0 #b17715}
.reward-chest-lock{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:145px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:77px;height:77px;border-radius:50%;border:8px solid #e69b12;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%,#ffefa5,#ffb925 75%);color:#7a4b00;font-size:49px;box-shadow:0 5px 9px #0d315170}
.reward-chest.is-open .reward-chest-lid{transform:rotate(-21deg) translate(-19px,-43px)}
.reward-chest.is-open::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:27px;width:70%;height:210px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#ffda7188,#ffdf5500 70%);animation:reward-pop .65s ease-out}
.reward-preview-found{z-index:8;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:3px solid #c6def2;border-radius:23px;padding:16px 34px 20px;background:#fffdfa;box-shadow:0 16px 35px #31567a24;max-width:90vw;animation:reward-pop .45s ease-out}
.reward-preview-found .reward-found-symbol{font-size:74px;line-height:1.15}
.reward-preview-found strong{font-size:24px;color:#071f54}
.reward-preview-end .actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:10px}
@keyframes reward-pop{from{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.83) translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}}
@keyframes reward-bounce{0%{transform:translateY(12px) scale(.92)}45%{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.04)}100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
body.no-motion .reward-preview-feedback,body.no-motion .reward-preview-feedback .reward-bot,body.no-motion .reward-preview-found{animation:none!important}
body.no-motion .reward-chest-lid{transition:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.reward-preview-feedback,.reward-preview-feedback .reward-bot,.reward-preview-found{animation:none!important}.reward-chest-lid{transition:none!important}}
@media(max-width:930px){body.reward-preview-mode .reward-preview-feedback{position:relative;top:auto;right:auto;z-index:8;width:calc(100% - 40px);margin:-12px 20px 16px;min-width:0;min-height:100px}.reward-preview-feedback .reward-bot{width:88px}.reward-preview-words{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:9px}.reward-preview-feedback strong{font-size:24px}.reward-preview-coin{width:41px;height:41px;font-size:27px}.reward-prototype-tools{justify-content:center;margin:14px 12px}.reward-preview-end{padding-top:40px!important}}
@media(max-width:520px){body.reward-preview-mode .reward-preview-feedback{padding:9px 11px;border-radius:18px}.reward-preview-feedback .reward-bot{width:60px}.reward-preview-feedback strong{font-size:20px}.reward-preview-feedback small{font-size:14px}.reward-chest{height:250px;transform:scale(.83);margin:-18px auto}.reward-preview-end h1{font-size:32px}.reward-preview-end .actions{flex-direction:column;width:100%}.reward-preview-end .actions button{width:100%}}


/* Coin-to-chest v2: the reward target stays visible in the QA viewport. */
body.reward-preview-mode .reward-vault{
  position:fixed;top:76px;right:clamp(105px,12vw,170px);z-index:90;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  min-width:135px;height:76px;padding:8px 11px;
  border:2px solid #ffd47f;border-radius:23px;background:#fff7e5;
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px #163b602e;
  font-size:28px;color:#071f54;
}
.reward-vault-number{font-weight:900;line-height:1}
/* Compact chest v3: one continuous body, a slightly hinged lid and a narrow slot. */
.reward-vault-chest{position:relative;display:block;width:62px;height:55px;flex:none;isolation:isolate;border:3px solid #d8910d;border-radius:16px 16px 12px 12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#2c91d1,#0b5293 70%,#07356c);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #f6cb61,inset 0 -3px 0 #092f62,0 3px 6px #06366133}
.reward-vault-lid{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:-3px;left:-4px;width:calc(100% + 8px);height:27px;border:4px solid #e8a321;border-bottom:4px solid #ffca57;border-radius:26px 26px 9px 9px;background:linear-gradient(95deg,#166db1,#41a8e0 50%,#155c9a);box-shadow:inset 0 4px #9edcff,0 2px 3px #07366d77;transform:rotate(-6deg);transform-origin:12% 95%}
.reward-vault-slot{position:absolute;z-index:4;top:20px;left:14px;width:30px;height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:#072954;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #ffca57}
.reward-vault-front{position:absolute;z-index:2;top:27px;left:1px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:calc(100% - 2px);height:calc(100% - 28px);border-top:3px solid #ecb344;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;background:linear-gradient(#1776bc,#0d4c8a);box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 #083467;color:#ffe08a;font-size:17px;line-height:1}
body.reward-preview-mode .reward-vault-received{animation:reward-vault-land .35s ease-out}
@keyframes reward-vault-land{0%{transform:scale(1)}45%{transform:scale(1.1);box-shadow:0 6px 25px #f5b9367a}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.reward-flying-coin{z-index:1000}
@media(max-width:600px){
  body.reward-preview-mode .reward-vault{top:96px;right:87px;min-width:125px;height:66px;padding:6px 9px;gap:6px;font-size:24px}
  .reward-vault-chest{transform:scale(.88);margin:-2px -3px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body.reward-preview-mode .reward-vault-received{animation:none!important}}
body.no-motion.reward-preview-mode .reward-vault-received{animation:none!important}


/* Zinbo profile v1: one local nickname plus eight consistent native SVG avatars. */
.op1-profile-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;flex:0 0 44px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}
.zinbo-avatar-svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.op1-profile-name{max-width:115px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.zinbo-profile-backdrop{position:fixed;z-index:1800;inset:0;background:#081c43a6}
.zinbo-profile-dialog{position:fixed;z-index:1801;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(540px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 110px);overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:linear-gradient(165deg,#ffffff,#f4faff);border:2px solid #cbe4f4;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 24px 90px #061e5380;color:#071f54;padding:24px 26px 17px;text-align:left}
.zinbo-profile-titlebar{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;margin-bottom:14px}
.zinbo-profile-titlebar h2{font-size:31px;line-height:1.15;margin:2px 0 0;font-weight:900}
.zinbo-profile-kicker{color:#2170aa;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.03em}
.zinbo-profile-close{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;background:#e4f3ff;color:#183d72;border-radius:50%;width:42px;height:42px;font-size:30px;line-height:1}
.zinbo-profile-dialog label,.zinbo-profile-choice-label{display:block;font-size:19px;font-weight:900;margin:12px 0 7px}
.zinbo-profile-dialog input{display:block;width:100%;height:52px;border:2px solid #b9d8f0;border-radius:13px;padding:9px 15px;background:#fff;font-size:20px;color:#0e305d;font-family:inherit}
.zinbo-profile-dialog small{color:#55718a;font-size:13px;display:block;margin:6px 0 16px}
.zinbo-profile-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:6px 0 22px}
.zinbo-profile-option{display:flex;position:relative;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:0;min-height:105px;border:2px solid #d6e4f1;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;color:#173d73;padding:9px 3px 7px;box-shadow:0 3px 9px #245a8b16}
.zinbo-profile-option .zinbo-avatar-svg{width:62px;height:62px}
.zinbo-profile-option span:not(.zinbo-profile-picked){font-size:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.zinbo-profile-option.is-picked{border:3px solid #168de1;background:#e8f5ff;box-shadow:0 3px 15px #168de13d}
.zinbo-profile-picked{position:absolute;right:4px;top:4px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;width:20px;height:20px;background:#1677c6;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:900}
.zinbo-profile-option:focus-visible,.zinbo-profile-dialog button:focus-visible,.zinbo-profile-dialog input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #126ec7;outline-offset:3px}
.zinbo-profile-dialog footer{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;margin:4px 0 8px}
.zinbo-profile-dialog footer button{min-height:47px;padding:10px 19px;border-radius:13px;font-size:17px;font-weight:900}
.zinbo-profile-cancel{border:2px solid #bfd7eb;background:#fff;color:#204b77}
.zinbo-profile-save{background:#108ce2;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 12px #1378c52b}
.zinbo-profile-local-note{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:#546d8a;line-height:1.4}
@media(max-width:520px){
 .op1-profile-avatar{width:34px;height:34px;flex-basis:34px}
 .op1-profile-name{max-width:73px}
 .zinbo-profile-dialog{top:calc(50% + 20px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 94px);padding:15px 14px 12px;border-radius:18px}
 .zinbo-profile-titlebar h2{font-size:25px}
 .zinbo-profile-options{gap:5px}
 .zinbo-profile-option{min-height:83px;padding:7px 2px 5px;border-radius:12px}
 .zinbo-profile-option .zinbo-avatar-svg{width:48px;height:48px}
 .zinbo-profile-option span:not(.zinbo-profile-picked){font-size:10px}
 .zinbo-profile-picked{width:16px;height:16px;font-size:11px}
 .zinbo-profile-dialog footer button{flex:1}
}

/* P0-08: keep the name and explanatory tagline visible on laptop widths. */
@media (min-width:881px) and (max-width:1450px){
  .op1-header{min-height:100px;height:auto;gap:12px}
  .op1-brand{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:3px;min-width:155px}
  .op1-brand strong{font-size:clamp(28px,2.65vw,38px)}
  .op1-brand strong::after{bottom:-3px}
  .op1-brand span{white-space:normal;font-size:clamp(13px,1.05vw,15px);line-height:1.2}
  .op1-toolbar{gap:7px}
  .op1-pill{padding:9px 11px}
}
